title: POC step 1: decode one public VI block diagram without LabVIEW and locate an editable logic change
body:
## Goal
The goal now requires a proof of concept (POC) before more benchmark work: an agent that never saw a VI describes its diagram and changes its logic without LabVIEW; the result opens in LabVIEW without a broken arrow, behaves as asked and keeps its save version. This task is step 1: measure whether the diagram of one small public VI can be decoded and changed from its bytes alone. Expected gain: a measured yes/no/partial with evidence, so the next session can order the edit tool or report the POC exits.

## Work
1. Pick ONE small public VI from the prepared sources under $LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT (for example a pylavi test VI with a simple arithmetic diagram). Record path, sha256 and save version (LVSR/vers resource).
2. Write a stdlib python3 script docs/research/poc/inspect_vi.py that lists the RSRC resources and tries to decode the block diagram heap (BDHx / compressed heap) into nodes, primitives, constants and wires. Reuse findings in docs/research/0002-delivery.md and any existing benchmark/ parsers; read them, do not edit benchmark/.
3. Write docs/research/poc/README.md: the decoded diagram description, which parts were decoded and which were not, one concrete candidate logic change (for example Add -> Subtract, or a constant value), the bytes that must change, the checksums or sizes that must be kept consistent, and the risk that LabVIEW shows a broken arrow.
4. End README.md with a line `poc-feasibility: yes|partial|no` and the evidence for it. Do not claim LabVIEW behaviour you did not observe: no LabVIEW is available, so opening in LabVIEW stays an owner check.

## Acceptance
- [ ] docs/research/poc/README.md exists with the selected VI, sha256, save version, decoded description and the poc-feasibility line.
- [ ] docs/research/poc/inspect_vi.py runs with python3 -I on the selected VI.
- [ ] Undecoded parts are listed as explicit gaps.

## Verification
`python3 -c "import sys; sys.exit('poc-feasibility:' not in open('docs/research/poc/README.md').read())"`

## Context
- docs/research/0002-delivery.md: earlier format and effort research.
- benchmark/dev/ and benchmark/native/readiness-case.json: public VIs already described (empty_separate_code.vi, pylavi tests).
- Do not run git commit; the parent commits. Do not use git diff in checks.

## Budget
- Bounded reads: never print a whole VI or a large JSON file; read at most 2,000 lines per file. Stay below 400k input tokens. Write README.md early and update it.
